page_title: MAR 0-0 TOU | Marseille v Toulouse 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' That's unlucky! Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mamady Bangre (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
90+3' Vitinha (Marseille) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Amine Harit (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
86' What a big chance! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
84' The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) is brought on as a substitute for Frank Magri.
83' The Marseille players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
80' Marcelino is stunned as referee Francois Letexier shows him a yellow card. What was that for?

79' This should have been a goal! Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.
79' Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
77' Frank Magri (Toulouse) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
77' A clumsy foul by Frank Magri (Toulouse) and Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Marseille.
76' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) brings an opponent down and Francois Letexier interrupts the game.
75' Vitinha (Marseille) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
72' Here is a change. Moussa Diarra is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Denis Genreau leaves the pitch and Mamady Bangre (Toulouse) comes on.
71' Amine Harit (Marseille) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
69' The referee blows for a cooling break.

68' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
68' Francois Letexier blows the whistle, Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is penalised for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Toulouse.
66' Marcelino has decided to substitute Joaquin Correa and he is replaced by Amine Harit (Marseille).
66' Substitution. Valentin Rongier makes his way off the pitch and Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) comes on as his replacement.
66' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
65' Renan Lodi (Marseille) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) picks up an injury.
64' Joaquin Correa (Marseille) has tested the patience of referee Francois Letexier and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
61' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
59' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Aron Donnum will be replaced by Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse).
59' Substitution. Vincent Sierro did his best and is replaced by Stijn Spierings (Toulouse).
58' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
58' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) leaps high to meet a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but his header rattles the left post!
57' The corner kick from Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
57' A quickly taken corner by Marseille.

57' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Now Marseille have a corner.
56' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) replacing Francois Regis Mughe.
56' Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) comes onto the pitch because Leonardo Balerdi simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
53' Flag up against Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
52' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
51' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) takes the corner but it's cleared.

46' Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Marseille are going to take it.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Marseille force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+4' Renan Lodi (Marseille) takes a mid-range free kick, but Guillaume Restes stops the ball from reaching the top of the net by tipping it onto the crossbar. Great save!
45+4' Francois Letexier blows his whistle for a foul after Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) hacks down one of his opponents. Marseille are awarded a free kick.
45+3' Vitinha (Marseille) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Guillaume Restes thwarts him with a nice save.
45+1' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Mikkel Desler (Toulouse).
42' Frank Magri (Toulouse) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.

41' Frank Magri (Toulouse) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Pau Lopez pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
40' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

39' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.

37' A neat pass finds Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Pau Lopez denies him with a good save.
36' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) serves up a nice cross, but Pau Lopez punches the ball away.
34' Looks like Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
31' This shall not pass! Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.

28' A sweet pass finds Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Guillaume Restes is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
28' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
26' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
25' Some patient build-up play from Marseille as they look to unlock the defence.
23' A cooling break is underway.
22' Francois Regis Mughe (Marseille) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
22' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jordan Veretout (Marseille), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

20' He should have scored! Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Pau Lopez makes an easy save.
17' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
17' The ball goes out for a corner. Marseille can continue in their attacking effort.
15' Frank Magri (Toulouse) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
13' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.

13' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is going to have a crack himself.
12' Logan Costa (Toulouse) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Marseille win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
11' Vitinha (Marseille) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Guillaume Restes.
6' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is able to continue to play.
5' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
4' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
1' The first half has started.
Toulouse will kick-off.
Francois Letexier will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
